Name: Tufted Chairs for DGA
Author: LynnNexus
Description:
A group of Tufted chairs in various lengths made using DGA.

So this is the first time I've actually -added- something to stardew rather than replaced something existing.  Took inspiration from a few other mods with fancy chairs.  This is largely just because a) I needed something to learn how to add furniture to the game with and b) I wanted fancy chairs but didn't wanna be restricted by how many couches/chairs were already in the game because c) I want all the couches and chairs in all the friggin colors.

My wood colors are largely compatible with starblue, I'm willing to add more/different colors if someone has a specific color they want.

Clearly this requires Dynamic Game Assets because I made this to learn how to do DGA
But after you install DGA, just unzip it into your mods folder.

I'm planning/hoping to add beds in a similar style, but that's gonna take hella learning.  I really feel like there needs to be more beds/bed options, but yea, I'm probably going to slowly add more furniture that will match this stuff.  Suggestions are welcomed.

1.2 Update:  Welp.  I said suggestions were welcomed and I guess I meant it!  XD  When I got a request for pastels I had nooooo clue what colors to do.  I am not a pink or light color person (As can probably be understood by my idea of "pastel" in the mod)  so after asking for clarification I was going to do Lavender and mint.  Only Lavender didn't look good to me with the blonde wood I'd picked and the Mint didn't look good when I tried to do white wood.  So Coral and Blue were added too.  For those who've already downloaded this before, I have altered the schedule on which they are sold.  They're sold in pairs of colors and I removed the quantity restriction.  No colors are sold on Tuesday and Sunday... And I think that's it. 

1.1 Update:  So I added an ottoman. There are two positions, one that takes up 1 tile and one that takes 2 tiles so it will be in the middle of a chair when they face down or are further from the chair.  It's largely for making pretty stuff happen but yea.  You can sit on or put stuff on it like a table.  I didn't wanna make it too much narrower so you can only sit on it facing the camera.

Downloads.Description: Added 4 new colors of chairs and altered how they show up in Robin's store.
